column1: # docs/release/zap-rules.tsv: the ZAP baseline scan's warnings this project has decided about.
# A warning blocks the release unless its rule is here. Columns, separated by tabs:
#   rule id    action (IGNORE, WARN, FAIL, INFO)    rule name    why
# IGNORE needs a real reason: this file is the answer to "why did you accept that?"
